A fan will always take the easy path
Air goes round the radiator rather than through it if there is a gap to go round. These flaps close those gaps, so the airflow the fan produces is airflow the core actually gets.
When these fail, something else gets blamed

A perished flap leaks nothing and makes no noise — the machine just runs hotter. The thermostat, the fan clutch and often the radiator get replaced first, and the strip that caused it costs almost nothing.
The gap is never the same twice

The distance between shroud and panel varies along the seal and between vehicles. A hard strip bridges the high spots and leaves the low ones open — we specify soft solid or closed-cell sponge so it follows the panel.
It lives behind an open grille
Sunlight, road spray, ozone and radiator heat, for the life of the machine. EPDM is our default here for that reason — and nitrile and SBR, the cheaper options, crack in exactly those conditions.

What is the minimum order quantity for this part?
We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted per metre where the flap is a cut strip. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes — and measure the gap, not only the old flap. A flap that has hardened has usually stopped touching the panel, and one that was too hard when new never touched it properly. The gap is the specification; the old part may never have met it.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?

PDF, DWG and DXF. A flat outline with the thickness marked is enough — add the smallest and largest gap the flap must close, and whether you want self-adhesive backing. A 3D model is not required for a cut flap.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness and tensile to ASTM D412 on solid grades, density and compression force deflection to ASTM D1056 on sponge grades, tested in-house.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?

TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment. Flaps ship flat and uncompressed.
